note: One statement a day for residents to agree or disagree with. Each comes from an open issue and is worded neutrally (rules in UPDATE.md). Only questions with status "approved" are shown. Results are what participants said, not what residents want.

questions.text: Conway's zoning rewrite should make room for more housing near the villages and limit big box development.
Conway should cap how much the school district's property tax can grow for the next two years.
The Rec Path should be extended through Whitaker Woods to Intervale, paid for with grants and donations.
The landfill's users should pay for the North Conway Water Precinct's $8 million treatment of PFAS in landfill leachate.
Bartlett should allow the proposed gravel pit off Route 16.
Bartlett's updated Master Plan should allow AI data centers in town, with conditions.
Jackson should offer property tax relief (RSA 79-E) to owners who fix up buildings in the village.
Commercial fireworks in Jackson should be allowed only in the Village District.
Madison should replace the Silver Lake dam now, even if federal money does not come through.
Carroll County's emergency radio equipment should be allowed to stay on the Eidelweiss tower site.
